Tendon aging is a complicated process caused by
multifaceted pathways and aging plays a critical role in
the occurrence and severity of tendon injury (3).
Due to an increasingly aged population, the occur-
rence of tendon-related injuries is also increasing. No
significant advances have been made in the treatment
of such conditions in recent years.

‘The purpose of this review is to is discuss the current

evidence on tendon aging, its treatment, and how this
‘can eventually create new targets for therapy.
